ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Addicted to Thrill: Though the version of Miraclo Rick Tyler now uses isn’t addictive, Tyler is almost uncontrollably drawn to the adrenaline rush of adventuring. When crime-fighting isn’t enough, he chases excitement through extreme sports. Hour of Power: Once Hourman takes a Miraclo injection, his powers last exactly an hour, and no more. In addition, he can’t take another injection for a full day. Travel to Timepoint is also limited to one hour. Power Couple: Rick Tyler fell in love and married another legacy hero—Jesse Chambers, the daughter of Johnny Quick and Liberty Belle. Together they joined the Justice Society and mentor other young heroes.
